about: #4449: the java-facade scenarios (each CICS scenario entered through the program's deployed entry point) that fail on committed equivalence ports, each case with the issue that owns the defect. tests/cobol_mainframe/test_evidence.py checks it against the evidence records.

genapp-lgapdb01.why: the java facade does not fire the scenario's declared sql_faults, and its clock differs from the oracle's in a no-commarea error-message text (the det sweep proves both)

genapp-lgupdb01.why: the java facade does not fire declared sql_faults (open/close cursor, UPDATE MOTOR +100), differs in the no-commarea error-message clock, and differs 6/10 on motor-request-for-endowment (the det sweep proves all 22)
